assets.name: cover_art
assets.prompt:
Low-poly art: flat-shaded polygon meshes with clean facets and hard edges, simple colour blocking, no visible cubes, no voxels.
A low-poly game scene based on this game design:
Cover art for 'Party Boat', a cozy first-person adventure aboard the Silja Symphonade, a big white Baltic overnight cruise ferry with a blue SILJA LINE hull stripe and a seal logo on the funnel. One single unified scene, not a collage: the white ferry sailing on a calm turquoise Baltic sea at golden evening light, with warm glowing windows, pine-covered skerries in the distance. In the foreground on the open deck, three cheerful rounded toy-like cartoon passengers (a blonde woman in a magenta blouse dancing, a man with a big belly in a teal party shirt holding a beer, a woman in a red jacket with a backpack) celebrate. Match the reference images' rendering exactly: smooth clean flat-shaded low-poly 3D, simple untextured matte surfaces, soft rounded shapes, bright whites and saturated blues, soft shadows. No faceted triangle shading, no painterly texture. No text or logos other than SILJA LINE on the hull.

Depict the world and atmosphere as a single illustrated scene. Low-poly art with flat-shaded facets and hard edges on every object, no cubes, no voxels, rendered as a highly polished 3D scene with the craft of a Pixar-quality animated film, cinematic lighting that fits the scene, soft ambient occlusion, rich detail and expressive composition. Wordless illustration, no text, no title, no words, no letters, no logos, no UI.

assets.name: Lift motor journey
assets.prompt: High fidelity close interior recording of a modern passenger ferry panoramic elevator electric motor. Gentle low smooth motor hum with a soft mechanical start, steady quiet ascent, subtle cable vibration, then gentle deceleration and a soft brake settling. One short elevator journey, luxurious quiet passenger lift, clean dry isolated sound effect, no voices, no music, no chime, no door sounds, no loud impacts.

assets.name: Lift arrival chime
assets.prompt: High fidelity isolated two-note arrival chime of an elegant modern passenger ferry elevator, warm clear ding dong, two mellow bell notes descending, clean attack and short natural metallic decay. Friendly understated lift arrival signal. No voice, no announcement, no music, no background noise.

assets.name: Keycard contact

One contact only, short clean tactile sound. Modern passenger ferry cabin lock, realistic, understated. No success melody, no denial buzzer, no voices, no music, no room noise.

assets.name: Keycard accepted
assets.prompt: High fidelity isolated electronic hotel keycard lock acceptance sound. Two short clean bright ascending beeps, polite quiet confirmation, realistic tiny speaker on a passenger ferry cabin card reader. Immediate onset, brief decay, compact and clear, no voice, no music, no door movement, no ambience.

assets.name: Keycard rejected
assets.prompt: High fidelity isolated electronic hotel keycard lock rejection sound. No voices, no music, no door movement, no background noise.

assets.name: Ferry door slide
assets.prompt: High fidelity close Foley of one modern passenger ferry powered sliding door opening. Immediate subtle latch click, smooth short brushed metal rail glide and soft pneumatic swish, ending with a gentle cushioned mechanical stop. Entire movement takes well under a second. Clean realistic dry isolated sound effect, refined quiet mechanism, no squeak, no slam, no beeps, no voices, no music, no background ambience.
